title: Extending Collatz k-Cycle Exclusion via Case Analysis

problemStatement.formal: Extend finite Collatz cycle case analysis with j=1 uniqueness, period-4 exclusions, halving lower bounds for j=5..8, and a bounded-cycle conclusion from the Eliahou lower-bound axiom.
problemStatement.plain: Formalizes a limited case-analysis extension for Collatz cycles: the file rules out several small cycle patterns, proves halving and cycle-length lower bounds for j=5 through j=8, and packages the result with the Eliahou cycle-bound axiom.
whyMatters: Shows exactly how far elementary finite case analysis can go before the known global cycle-bound result is needed.
Keeps the Collatz cycle-extension catalog entry aligned with its dedicated Lean source instead of the parent Collatz file.

proven: j1_cycle_equation_unique proves the j=1 cycle equation forces n=1 and M=2.
j1_cycle_period_three_only and no_j1_period4_cycle rule out selected period-4 cases.
min_halvings_five_odd through min_halvings_eight_odd prove halving lower bounds for j=5..8.
min_cycle_length_j5 through min_cycle_length_j8 derive corresponding minimum cycle lengths.
oq01_case_analysis_limited combines finite case analysis with the Eliahou cycle-bound axiom.
